content_of_post_to_comment: I only wanted to look at stuff from marketplace or look at rooms for rent. However I made the mistake of scrolling down the homepage , which shows me a bunch of sexist content that I didn't follow. And racist content too. Now I am thinking of deleting the account but it is so hard to sell shit on any other site . Anybody on here ended up creating a Facebook for the same reason and now regret it?
comment: The marketplace part is the frustrating thing with Facebook because it has become one of those tools people keep around despite disliking the rest of the experience. I ended up treating my account more like a utility: unfollowing everything, avoiding the feed, and only using groups or Marketplace. It’s not perfect, but it cuts down a lot of the unwanted stuff without losing the useful parts.
